en: The image shows the back of an old postcard with handwritten notes and printed text. The most prominent printed text is 'Solveig Lund CHRISTIANIA.' in a decorative script across the center, and 'Kopiering forbydes.' at the bottom. Handwritten notes and numbers, including '75', 'NF 15.229', and some crossed-out text, are visible. The general appearance and language indicate Scandinavian origin.
